description: Generate a PNG waveform image from an audio or video file. Returns the file path and inlined base64 image data.

color.description: Waveform color in hex or name (such as '0x6366f1', 'white', or 'black'). Default: '0x6366f1'.

includeBase64.description: Return base64 image data in the response for vision models. Default: true.

inputPath.description: Path to the audio or video file.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the PNG image.

name: generate_waveform
